parameters.content:
## Verify Polish VAT taxpayers (Biała lista) from Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow verifies Polish VAT taxpayers from a Google Sheets contractor list against the Ministry of Finance Biała lista API. It can be started manually or on a weekday schedule, reads contractor data, normalizes and validates NIP numbers, calls the API, and turns the response into a plain verdict.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials for the Read contractors node and select the spreadsheet/range containing contractor data.
- Update the Settings node with the correct whiteListApi endpoint and the column names for NIP, contractor name, and bank account.
- Confirm the weekday schedule time and timezone on the Every weekday 7:00 trigger, or use the manual trigger for ad hoc checks.
- Review the Prepare NIPs and Evaluate results code nodes if your sheet uses different formatting or you need different output fields.

### Customization

Adjust the Settings node to point to different sheet columns or API environments, change the schedule frequency, or extend the evaluation code to write results back to Google Sheets, send alerts, or include bank-account matching.

## Start and configure

Contains the manual and weekday scheduled triggers, then centralizes runtime settings such as the Biała lista API URL and spreadsheet column names.

## Read and prepare NIPs

Reads contractor rows from Google Sheets and normalizes the NIP values from the configured column, including checksum validation before lookup.

## Check and evaluate taxpayers

Queries the Ministry of Finance white list API for each prepared NIP and converts the response into a clear taxpayer verification verdict.
